quote: CCF and NKA troop assembly in Pyonggang-Chorwon-Kumhwa triangle on 27-29 December 1950. Estimated casualties from six 40-KT air bursts, 30,000 to 45,000
notes: Hindsight case study. Appendix B (printed pp.153-155) gives aiming-point schemes of 6 or 10 bombs and calls Pyonggang "probably the most important" aiming point "with Chorwon a close second".
